entry.title: Scribus 1.7.1 Released
entry.summary: The Scribus Team is pleased to announce the release of version 1.7.1. This is a bugfix release with the following changes. Changes General Security Future Scribus 1.7.x is the new unstable series. While we will maintain Scribus 1.6.x as a stable version, most development will focus on 1.7.x and features and Qt6-based enhancements. 1.7.x.svn is ... More
